CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tax_vehicle_command_manifest_immutable()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$begin
 if old.choices is distinct from new.choices or old.before_state is distinct from new.before_state or old.plan is distinct from new.plan or old.actor_user_id is distinct from new.actor_user_id or old.business_id is distinct from new.business_id or old.tax_year is distinct from new.tax_year or (old.consumed_at is not null and new is distinct from old) then raise exception 'vehicle_manifest_immutable' using errcode='42501';end if;return new;end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tax_vehicle_command_state(b uuid, y integer)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
 select jsonb_build_object(
  'classifications',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(c) order by c.id) from public.transaction_tax_classifications c where c.business_id=b and c.tax_year=y),'[]'::jsonb),
  'sourceTransactions',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'signedAmount',t.signed_amount,'amount',t.amount,'direction',t.direction,'date',t.date,'pending',t.pending,'archived',t.is_archived) order by t.id) from public.bank_transactions t where t.business_id=b and exists(select 1 from public.transaction_tax_classifications c where c.transaction_id=t.id and c.business_id=b and c.tax_year=y)),'[]'::jsonb),
  'vehicles',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(v) order by v.id) from public.tax_vehicles v where v.business_id=b),'[]'::jsonb),
  'elections',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(e) order by e.id) from public.tax_vehicle_method_elections e where e.business_id=b and e.tax_year=y and e.status in ('active','finalized')),'[]'::jsonb),
  'mileage',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(m) order by m.id) from public.tax_vehicle_mileage_inputs m where m.business_id=b and m.tax_year=y and m.status in ('active','finalized','inactive') and m.superseded_by is null),'[]'::jsonb),
  'assignments',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a) order by a.transaction_id) from public.tax_vehicle_transaction_assignments a where a.business_id=b and a.tax_year=y),'[]'::jsonb),
  'rates',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) order by r.id) from public.tax_vehicle_mileage_rates r where r.status='active' and r.purpose='business' and r.effective_start<=make_date(y,12,31) and r.effective_end>=make_date(y,1,1)),'[]'::jsonb),
  'projection',(select jsonb_build_object('id',p.id,'sourceFingerprint',p.source_fingerprint) from public.tax_workspace_projections p where p.business_id=b and p.tax_year=y and p.projection_version='tax-workspace-v2' and p.status='complete' order by p.generated_at desc,p.created_at desc limit 1)
 );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tax_category_resolution_facts(m jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare confidence numeric:=0; suggestion text:=''; raw_confidence text:=m->'tax_category_suggestion'->>'confidence';begin
 if raw_confidence ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' then confidence:=raw_confidence::numeric;if confidence<=1 then confidence:=confidence*100;end if;end if;
 if confidence between 80 and 100 and m->'tax_category_suggestion'->>'taxCategory' in ('supplies','office_expense','advertising','bank_fees','interest_expense','taxes_licenses','legal_professional','business_insurance','software_subscriptions','equipment_rental','rent_lease','personal_expense','entertainment') then suggestion:=m->'tax_category_suggestion'->>'taxCategory';end if;
 return jsonb_build_object('suggestedCategory',suggestion,'reasonCode',coalesce(nullif(m->>'review_reason_code',''),nullif(m->>'reason_code',''),'category_review'));
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.apply_grouped_tax_category_decision(p_business_id uuid, p_tax_year integer, p_actor_user_id uuid, p_override_source text, p_override_reason text, p_idempotency_key text, p_scope jsonb, p_scope_fingerprint text, p_target_transaction_ids jsonb, p_expected_population_transaction_ids jsonb, p_items jsonb, p_rule jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_existing public.tax_grouped_deduction_decision_operations%rowtype;
  v_rule public.tax_deduction_rules%rowtype;
  v_operation_id uuid := gen_random_uuid();
  v_result jsonb;
  v_classifications jsonb;
  v_target_count integer;
  v_expected_population_count integer;
  v_item_count integer;
  v_population jsonb;
  v_account_id text;
  v_tax_category text;
  v_rule_code text;
begin
  if p_business_id is null
     or p_tax_year is null or p_tax_year < 2000 or p_tax_year > 2100
     or p_idempotency_key is null or length(trim(p_idempotency_key)) < 16
     or p_scope_fingerprint is null or length(trim(p_scope_fingerprint)) = 0
     or jsonb_typeof(p_scope) is distinct from 'object'
     or jsonb_typeof(p_target_transaction_ids) is distinct from 'array'
     or jsonb_typeof(p_expected_population_transaction_ids) is distinct from 'array'
     or jsonb_typeof(p_items) is distinct from 'array'
     or jsonb_typeof(p_rule) is distinct from 'object' then
    raise exception 'invalid_grouped_tax_deduction_decision'
      using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  v_target_count := jsonb_array_length(p_target_transaction_ids);
  v_expected_population_count := jsonb_array_length(p_expected_population_transaction_ids);
  v_item_count := jsonb_array_length(p_items);
  if v_target_count < 1 or v_target_count > 1000
     or v_expected_population_count < 1 or v_expected_population_count > 1000
     or v_item_count <> v_target_count then
    raise exception 'invalid_grouped_tax_deduction_decision: selected transaction count is invalid'
      using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  v_tax_category := nullif(trim(p_scope->>'tax_category'), '');
  v_account_id := nullif(trim(p_scope->>'qbo_account_id'), '');
  v_rule_code := nullif(trim(p_rule->>'rule_code'), '');
  if v_tax_category is null or v_account_id is null or v_rule_code is null
     or coalesce(p_scope->>'decision_type','') not in ('category_confirmation','rent_treatment')
     or coalesce(p_rule->>'tax_category','') not in ('supplies','office_expense','advertising','bank_fees','interest_expense','taxes_licenses','legal_professional','business_insurance','software_subscriptions','equipment_rental','rent_lease','personal_expense','entertainment')
     or nullif(trim(p_override_reason), '') is null then
    raise exception 'invalid_grouped_tax_deduction_decision: scope, rule, and reason are required'
      using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  -- Serialize duplicate/submitted-again commands for this tenant/key without
  -- holding a broad business lock. The unique key is still the final guard.
  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(p_business_id::text || ':' || p_idempotency_key, 0));

  -- A different idempotency key can legitimately be used after the prior
  -- command has finished, but two concurrent commands must not both create
  -- competing defaults for the same company/year/GL scope.
  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(
    p_business_id::text || ':' || p_tax_year::text || ':' || v_tax_category || ':' || v_account_id,
    0
  ));

  select * into v_existing
  from public.tax_grouped_deduction_decision_operations
  where business_id = p_business_id
    and idempotency_key = p_idempotency_key
  for update;

  if found then
    if v_existing.scope_fingerprint is distinct from p_scope_fingerprint
       or v_existing.scope is distinct from p_scope then
      raise exception 'idempotency_key_reused'
        using errcode = '40001';
    end if;
    return v_existing.result;
  end if;

  -- Validate that the caller supplied one unique item for every selected ID,
  -- and that every selected row remains an active canonical transaction in
  -- this exact business/year/category/GL scope. This is the authoritative
  -- stale-scope check; the client fingerprint is only an early guard.
  if exists (
    with target_ids as (
      select value::text as transaction_id
      from jsonb_array_elements_text(p_target_transaction_ids) value
    ), expected_population_ids as (
      select value::text as transaction_id
      from jsonb_array_elements_text(p_expected_population_transaction_ids) value
    ), item_ids as (
      select nullif(item->>'transaction_id', '') as transaction_id
      from jsonb_array_elements(p_items) item
    )
    select 1
    where (select count(*) from target_ids) <> (select count(distinct transaction_id) from target_ids)
       or (select count(*) from expected_population_ids) <> (select count(distinct transaction_id) from expected_population_ids)
       or (select count(*) from item_ids) <> (select count(distinct transaction_id) from item_ids)
       or exists (select 1 from target_ids t full join item_ids i using (transaction_id) where t.transaction_id is null or i.transaction_id is null)
       or exists (
         select 1
         from target_ids t
         left join expected_population_ids p using (transaction_id)
         where p.transaction_id is null
       )
  ) then
    raise exception 'grouped_decision_scope_changed'
      using errcode = '40001';
  end if;

  -- The browser may choose exceptions (a subset of this set), but it cannot
  -- choose the population. Compare the submitted sorted stable-ID set with
  -- the current canonical active source rows under the same tenant/year/GL
  -- scope while the scope advisory lock is held.
  if exists (
    with expected_population_ids as (
      select value::text as transaction_id
      from jsonb_array_elements_text(p_expected_population_transaction_ids) value
    ), canonical_population_ids as (
      select c.transaction_id::text as transaction_id
      from public.transaction_tax_classifications c
      join public.bank_transactions b
        on b.business_id = c.business_id
       and b.id = c.transaction_id
      where c.business_id = p_business_id
        and c.tax_year = p_tax_year
        and c.tax_category = v_tax_category
        and public.tax_category_resolution_facts(c.metadata) = p_scope->'resolution_facts'
        and coalesce(c.source_qbo_account_id, c.metadata->>'source_qbo_account_id') = v_account_id
        and c.classification_status = 'needs_review'
        and c.requires_review is true
        and coalesce(c.user_override, false) is false
        and coalesce(c.cpa_override, false) is false
        and b.pending is not true
        and b.is_archived is not true
    )
    select 1
    where (select count(*) from expected_population_ids) <> (select count(*) from canonical_population_ids)
       or exists (
         select 1
         from expected_population_ids e
         full join canonical_population_ids c using (transaction_id)
         where e.transaction_id is null or c.transaction_id is null
       )
  ) then
    raise exception 'grouped_decision_population_changed'
      using errcode = '40001';
  end if;

  if exists (
    with item_rows as (
      select
        nullif(item->>'transaction_id', '')::uuid as transaction_id,
        nullif(item->>'classification_id', '')::uuid as classification_id,
        nullif(item->>'expected_updated_at', '')::timestamptz as expected_updated_at,
        nullif(item->>'tax_category', '') as tax_category,
        nullif(item->>'classification_status', '') as classification_status,
        nullif(item->>'requires_review', '')::boolean as requires_review
      from jsonb_array_elements(p_items) item
    )
    select 1
    from item_rows i
    left join public.transaction_tax_classifications c
      on c.business_id = p_business_id
     and c.tax_year = p_tax_year
     and c.transaction_id = i.transaction_id
    left join public.bank_transactions b
      on b.business_id = p_business_id
     and b.id = i.transaction_id
    where i.transaction_id is null
       or i.classification_id is null
       or i.tax_category is distinct from p_rule->>'tax_category'
       or i.classification_status is distinct from 'user_confirmed'
       or i.requires_review is not false
       or c.id is null
       or c.id is distinct from i.classification_id
       or (i.expected_updated_at is not null and c.updated_at is distinct from i.expected_updated_at)
       or c.tax_category is distinct from v_tax_category
       or coalesce(c.source_qbo_account_id, c.metadata->>'source_qbo_account_id') is distinct from v_account_id
       or c.classification_status is distinct from 'needs_review'
       or c.requires_review is not true
       or coalesce(c.user_override, false) is true
       or coalesce(c.cpa_override, false) is true
       or b.id is null
       or b.pending is true
       or b.is_archived is true
  ) then
    raise exception 'grouped_decision_scope_changed'
      using errcode = '40001';
  end if;

  -- Explicit category answers apply only to reviewed members. Never infer a
  -- future GL-wide tax rule from heterogeneous unresolved purchases.
  with items as (
    select
      nullif(item->>'classification_id', '')::uuid as classification_id,
      nullif(item->>'transaction_id', '')::uuid as transaction_id,
      item
    from jsonb_array_elements(p_items) item
  ), locked as (
    select c.*, i.item
    from public.transaction_tax_classifications c
    join items i on i.classification_id = c.id and i.transaction_id = c.transaction_id
    where c.business_id = p_business_id
      and c.tax_year = p_tax_year
      and c.tax_category = v_tax_category
      and coalesce(c.source_qbo_account_id, c.metadata->>'source_qbo_account_id') = v_account_id
      and c.classification_status = 'needs_review'
      and c.requires_review is true
      and coalesce(c.user_override, false) is false
      and coalesce(c.cpa_override, false) is false
      and (
        nullif(i.item->>'expected_updated_at', '') is null
        or c.updated_at = nullif(i.item->>'expected_updated_at', '')::timestamptz
      )
    for update of c
  ), history as (
    insert into public.tax_classification_overrides (
      business_id, tax_year, transaction_id, classification_id, previous_values, new_values,
      override_source, override_reason, overridden_by, created_at
    )
    select
      p_business_id, p_tax_year, l.transaction_id, l.id,
      jsonb_build_object(
        'tax_category', l.tax_category,
        'deductibility_status', l.deductibility_status,
        'deductible_percent', l.deductible_percent,
        'book_amount', l.book_amount,
        'deductible_amount', l.deductible_amount,
        'nondeductible_amount', l.nondeductible_amount,
        'capitalizable_amount', l.capitalizable_amount,
        'tax_treatment', l.tax_treatment,
        'classification_status', l.classification_status,
        'confidence_score', l.confidence_score,
        'confidence_level', l.confidence_level,
        'source', l.source,
        'requires_review', l.requires_review,
        'reason', l.reason,
        'user_override', l.user_override,
        'cpa_override', l.cpa_override,
        'metadata', l.metadata
      ),
      jsonb_build_object(
        'tax_category', l.item->>'tax_category',
        'deductibility_status', l.item->>'deductibility_status',
        'deductible_percent', (l.item->>'deductible_percent')::numeric,
        'book_amount', (l.item->>'book_amount')::numeric,
        'deductible_amount', (l.item->>'deductible_amount')::numeric,
        'nondeductible_amount', (l.item->>'nondeductible_amount')::numeric,
        'capitalizable_amount', (l.item->>'capitalizable_amount')::numeric,
        'tax_treatment', coalesce(l.item->'tax_treatment', 'null'::jsonb),
        'classification_status', l.item->>'classification_status',
        'confidence_score', (l.item->>'confidence_score')::numeric,
        'confidence_level', l.item->>'confidence_level',
        'source', l.item->>'source',
        'requires_review', (l.item->>'requires_review')::boolean,
        'reason', l.item->>'reason',
        'user_override', coalesce((l.item->>'user_override')::boolean, false) or (l.item->>'classification_status') = 'user_confirmed',
        'cpa_override', coalesce((l.item->>'cpa_override')::boolean, false) or coalesce(l.cpa_override, false) or (l.item->>'classification_status') = 'cpa_confirmed',
        'metadata', coalesce(l.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) || coalesce(l.item->'metadata', '{}'::jsonb)
      ),
      p_override_source, p_override_reason, p_actor_user_id, now()
    from locked l
  ), updated as (
    update public.transaction_tax_classifications c
    set
      tax_category = l.item->>'tax_category',
      deductibility_status = l.item->>'deductibility_status',
      deductible_percent = (l.item->>'deductible_percent')::numeric,
      book_amount = (l.item->>'book_amount')::numeric,
      deductible_amount = (l.item->>'deductible_amount')::numeric,
      nondeductible_amount = (l.item->>'nondeductible_amount')::numeric,
      capitalizable_amount = (l.item->>'capitalizable_amount')::numeric,
      tax_treatment = coalesce(l.item->'tax_treatment', 'null'::jsonb),
      classification_status = l.item->>'classification_status',
      confidence_score = (l.item->>'confidence_score')::numeric,
      confidence_level = l.item->>'confidence_level',
      source = l.item->>'source',
      requires_review = (l.item->>'requires_review')::boolean,
      reason = l.item->>'reason',
      user_override = coalesce((l.item->>'user_override')::boolean, false) or (l.item->>'classification_status') = 'user_confirmed',
      cpa_override = coalesce((l.item->>'cpa_override')::boolean, false) or coalesce(c.cpa_override, false) or (l.item->>'classification_status') = 'cpa_confirmed',
      metadata = coalesce(c.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) || coalesce(l.item->'metadata', '{}'::jsonb),
      updated_at = now()
    from locked l
    where c.id = l.id
    returning c.*
  ), resolved_review_tasks as (
    update public.tax_review_tasks t
    set
      status = 'resolved',
      resolved_by = p_actor_user_id,
      resolved_at = now(),
      updated_at = now()
    where t.business_id = p_business_id
      and t.dedupe_key in (
        select 'tax_classification:' || p_tax_year::text || ':' || updated.transaction_id::text
        from updated
      )
    returning t.id
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(updated) order by updated.transaction_id), '[]'::jsonb)
  into v_classifications
  from updated;

  if jsonb_array_length(v_classifications) <> v_target_count then
    raise exception 'grouped_decision_scope_changed'
      using errcode = '40001';
  end if;

  select jsonb_build_object(
    'category_transaction_count', count(*)::integer,
    'actionable_transaction_count', count(*) filter (
      where c.classification_status = 'needs_review'
        and c.requires_review is true
        and coalesce(c.user_override, false) is false
        and coalesce(c.cpa_override, false) is false
    )::integer,
    'already_resolved_count', count(*) filter (
      where c.classification_status in ('user_confirmed', 'cpa_confirmed')
        or coalesce(c.user_override, false) is true
        or coalesce(c.cpa_override, false) is true
    )::integer,
    'explicitly_excluded_count', count(*) filter (where c.classification_status = 'excluded')::integer
  )
  into v_population
  from public.transaction_tax_classifications c
  join public.bank_transactions b on b.business_id = c.business_id and b.id = c.transaction_id
  where c.business_id = p_business_id
    and c.tax_year = p_tax_year
    and c.tax_category = v_tax_category
    and coalesce(c.source_qbo_account_id, c.metadata->>'source_qbo_account_id') = v_account_id
    and b.pending is not true
    and b.is_archived is not true;

  v_result := jsonb_build_object(
    'operation_id', v_operation_id,
    'status', 'completed',
    'idempotency_key', p_idempotency_key,
    'scope_fingerprint', p_scope_fingerprint,
    'applied_count', v_target_count,
    'already_matching_count', 0,
    'skipped_count', 0,
    'skipped_reasons', '[]'::jsonb,
    'target_transaction_ids', p_target_transaction_ids,
    'expected_population_transaction_ids', p_expected_population_transaction_ids,
    'classifications', v_classifications,
    'rule', to_jsonb(v_rule),
    'population', v_population
  );

  insert into public.tax_grouped_deduction_decision_operations (
    id, business_id, tax_year, idempotency_key, scope, scope_fingerprint,
    target_transaction_ids, expected_population_transaction_ids, target_count, applied_count, already_matching_count,
    skipped_count, skipped_reasons, resulting_rule_id, status, result, actor_user_id
  ) values (
    v_operation_id, p_business_id, p_tax_year, p_idempotency_key, p_scope, p_scope_fingerprint,
    p_target_transaction_ids, p_expected_population_transaction_ids, v_target_count, v_target_count, 0,
    0, '[]'::jsonb, v_rule.id, 'completed', v_result, p_actor_user_id
  );

  return v_result;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tax_reject_final_temporary_category()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$ begin
 if new.classification_status in ('user_confirmed','cpa_confirmed','bizzi_operator_confirmed','accountant_reviewed') and lower(trim(coalesce(new.tax_category,''))) in ('','unclassified','unresolved','needs_review','pending','pending_classification','unknown','not_determined') then raise exception 'temporary_tax_category' using errcode='22023';end if;
 return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.classify_plaid_account_recovery_rows(p_business_id uuid, p_plaid_env text, p_plaid_account_id text)
 RETURNS TABLE(transaction_id uuid, initial_target boolean, classification text, evidence_version text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
  select bt.id,
    not bt.is_archived and tc.id is null and r.id is null,
    case
      when bt.is_archived or bt.archived_reason is not null then 'protected_removed_transaction'
      when r.status = 'processing' and r.locked_at>now()-interval '10 minutes' then 'active_processing_lease'
      when r.status = 'processing' then 'stale_processing_lease'
      when r.status = 'dead_letter' then 'unresolved_dead_letter'
      when tc.status in ('matched','matched_existing_qbo') or tc.reconciled_at is not null then 'existing_match'
      when q.id is not null or tc.qbo_txn_id is not null or tc.posted_at is not null then 'existing_posting_intent_or_receipt'
      when tc.status in ('excluded','ignored','approved','auto_approved','handled','posted') then 'completed_decision'
      when bt.pending then 'pending_transaction'
      when bt.accounting_review_reason ilike '%duplicate%'
        or tc.meta->>'possible_qbo_duplicate' = 'true'
        or bt.raw->>'possible_qbo_duplicate' = 'true' then 'possible_qbo_duplicate'
      when bt.accounting_review_required or tc.accounting_review_required then 'manual_review_required'
      when bt.direction is distinct from 'OUTFLOW' or bt.check_number is not null
        or coalesce(bt.transaction_type,'') ~* '(transfer|refund|payroll|tax|loan|payment)'
        or coalesce(bt.name,'') ~* '(\m(transfer|payroll|loan|refund|autopay)\M|DEPOSIT INTUIT|TRAN FEE INTUIT)'
        or coalesce(bt.raw->>'source','plaid') ~* '(csv|manual)'
        or bt.plaid_transaction_id is null then 'protected_workflow'
      when tc.id is not null then 'existing_categorization'
      when r.id is not null then 'existing_processing_admission'
      else 'eligible_residual_orphan'
    end,
    encode(sha256(convert_to(jsonb_build_array(to_jsonb(bt), to_jsonb(tc), to_jsonb(r), to_jsonb(q))::text, 'UTF8')), 'hex')
  from public.bank_transactions bt
  join public.plaid_accounts a on a.business_id = bt.business_id and a.plaid_env = bt.plaid_env
    and a.plaid_account_id = bt.plaid_account_id
  left join public.transaction_categorizations tc on tc.business_id = bt.business_id and tc.transaction_id = bt.id
  left join public.bookkeeping_processing_requests r on r.business_id = bt.business_id and r.transaction_id = bt.id
  left join public.qbo_posted_transactions q on q.business_id = bt.business_id and q.transaction_id = bt.id
  where bt.business_id = p_business_id and bt.plaid_env = p_plaid_env and bt.plaid_account_id = p_plaid_account_id;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_plaid_account_recovery_facts(p_business_id uuid, p_plaid_env text, p_qbo_env text DEFAULT 'production'::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  a record; i public.plaid_items%rowtype; latest jsonb; successful jsonb;
  metrics jsonb; accounts jsonb := '[]';
  token_status text; token_at timestamptz; token_active boolean; token_connected_at timestamptz; policy boolean;
begin
  select auto_post_to_quickbooks into policy from public.business_profiles where id = p_business_id;
  select status, disconnected_at,is_active,coalesce(last_connected_at,created_at) into token_status, token_at,token_active,token_connected_at
    from public.quickbooks_tokens where business_id = p_business_id and qbo_env = p_qbo_env
    order by created_at desc limit 1;
  for a in select * from public.plaid_accounts where business_id = p_business_id and plaid_env = p_plaid_env order by id loop
    select * into i from public.plaid_items where business_id = p_business_id and plaid_env = p_plaid_env
      and plaid_item_id = a.plaid_item_id;
    select jsonb_build_object('id',id,'status',status,'started_at',started_at,'finished_at',finished_at,
      'failure_code',failure_code,'stage',meta->>'failure_stage','database_stage',meta->>'database_stage',
      'source_error_code',meta->>'source_error_code','reason',meta->>'reason') into latest
      from public.bank_sync_runs where business_id = p_business_id and plaid_item_id = a.plaid_item_id
      order by started_at desc, id desc limit 1;
    select jsonb_build_object('id',id,'started_at',started_at,'finished_at',finished_at) into successful
      from public.bank_sync_runs where business_id = p_business_id and plaid_item_id = a.plaid_item_id
        and status = 'completed' order by finished_at desc, id desc limit 1;
    select jsonb_build_object(
      'active_count', count(*), 'first_transaction_date', min(bt.date), 'latest_transaction_date', max(bt.date),
      'last_persisted_at', max(bt.created_at), 'last_mutation_at',max(bt.updated_at), 'last_observed_at',max(bt.last_seen_at),
      'missing_categorization',count(*) filter(where tc.id is null),
      'missing_processing_admission',count(*) filter(where r.id is null),
      'missing_both',count(*) filter(where tc.id is null and r.id is null),
      'required_processing_admission_missing',count(*) filter(where r.id is null and (tc.id is null or tc.status in ('needs_review','uncategorized','failed'))),
      'processing_count',count(*) filter(where r.status in ('pending','processing','failed') and (tc.id is null or tc.status in ('needs_review','uncategorized','failed'))),
      'active_lease_count',count(*) filter(where r.status = 'processing' and r.locked_at>now()-interval '10 minutes' and (tc.id is null or tc.status in ('needs_review','uncategorized','failed'))),
      'stale_lease_count',count(*) filter(where r.status='processing' and (r.locked_at is null or r.locked_at<=now()-interval '10 minutes') and (tc.id is null or tc.status in ('needs_review','uncategorized','failed'))),
      'dead_letter_count',count(*) filter(where r.status = 'dead_letter' and (tc.id is null or tc.status in ('needs_review','uncategorized','failed'))),
      'automation_failed_count',count(*) filter(where r.status in ('failed','dead_letter') and (tc.id is null or tc.status in ('needs_review','uncategorized','failed'))),
      'automation_due_count',count(*) filter(where r.status in ('pending','failed') and r.attempt_count<r.max_attempts and greatest(r.process_after,coalesce(r.blocked_until,r.process_after))<=now()),
      'review_count',count(*) filter(where (tc.status in ('needs_review','uncategorized') or (bt.accounting_review_required and coalesce(tc.status,'') not in ('excluded','ignored'))) and not bt.pending),
      'automation_last_attempt_at',max(coalesce(r.locked_at,r.processed_at,case when r.attempt_count>0 then r.updated_at end)),
      'automation_last_success_at',max(r.processed_at) filter(where r.status in ('completed','skipped')),
      'automation_error_at',max(r.updated_at) filter(where r.status in ('failed','dead_letter')),
      'automation_retry_candidate_at',min(greatest(r.process_after,coalesce(r.blocked_until,r.process_after)))
        filter(where r.status='failed' and r.attempt_count>0 and r.attempt_count < r.max_attempts
          and greatest(r.process_after,coalesce(r.blocked_until,r.process_after)) > now()),
      'posting_hold_count',count(*) filter(where tc.posting_hold_batch_id is not null and coalesce(b.posting_hold,true)),
      'receipt_reconciliation_count',count(*) filter(where q.status in ('pending','unknown','processing')),
      'posting_failed_count',count(*) filter(where q.status = 'failed' or tc.posting_status = 'posting_failed'),
      'posting_last_attempt_at',max(coalesce(q.last_attempt_at,tc.last_post_attempt_at)),
      'posting_last_success_at',max(q.posted_at) filter(where q.status = 'posted'),
      'posting_error_at',max(coalesce(q.last_attempt_at,q.updated_at,tc.updated_at))
        filter(where q.status = 'failed' or tc.posting_status = 'posting_failed'),
      'qbo_auth_error_at',max(coalesce(q.last_attempt_at,q.updated_at,tc.updated_at)) filter(where
        coalesce(q.last_error->>'code',tc.post_error,'') in
          ('invalid_grant','qbo_reconnect_required','qbo_auth_required','vendor_qbo_auth_required','AuthenticationFailed')
        and coalesce(q.status,'')<>'posted' and coalesce(tc.status,'')<>'posted')
    ) into metrics
    from public.bank_transactions bt
    left join public.transaction_categorizations tc on tc.business_id = bt.business_id and tc.transaction_id = bt.id
    left join public.bookkeeping_processing_requests r on r.business_id = bt.business_id and r.transaction_id = bt.id
    left join public.qbo_posted_transactions q on q.business_id = bt.business_id and q.transaction_id = bt.id and q.qbo_env = p_qbo_env
    left join public.plaid_recovery_batches b on b.id = tc.posting_hold_batch_id and b.business_id = bt.business_id
    where bt.business_id = p_business_id and bt.plaid_env = p_plaid_env
      and bt.plaid_account_id = a.plaid_account_id and not bt.is_archived;
    -- Ledger reconciliation and held cohorts remain relevant after a bank row
    -- is archived. Imported date/count metrics above remain active-only.
    metrics := metrics || jsonb_build_object(
      'recovery_gap_review_count',(select count(*) from public.plaid_recovery_batches g where g.business_id=p_business_id
        and g.plaid_env=p_plaid_env and g.plaid_item_id=a.plaid_item_id and g.summary->>'workflow_kind'='reviewed_recovery'
        and g.summary->'before'->>'account_id'=a.plaid_account_id and g.status='preview_ready'),
      'posting_hold_count',(select count(*) from public.transaction_categorizations tc
        join public.bank_transactions bt on bt.id=tc.transaction_id and bt.business_id=tc.business_id
        join public.plaid_recovery_batches rb on rb.id=tc.posting_hold_batch_id and rb.business_id=tc.business_id
        where tc.business_id=p_business_id and bt.plaid_env=p_plaid_env and bt.plaid_account_id=a.plaid_account_id and rb.posting_hold),
      'receipt_reconciliation_count',(select count(*) from public.qbo_posted_transactions q
        join public.bank_transactions bt on bt.id=q.transaction_id and bt.business_id=q.business_id
        where q.business_id=p_business_id and bt.plaid_env=p_plaid_env and bt.plaid_account_id=a.plaid_account_id
          and q.qbo_env=p_qbo_env and q.status in ('pending','unknown','processing'))
    );
    accounts := accounts || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
      'account',jsonb_build_object('id',a.plaid_account_id,'plaid_item_id',a.plaid_item_id,'name',a.name,'mask',a.mask,
        'connection_state',a.connection_state,'is_active',a.is_active,'disconnected_at',a.disconnected_at,'updated_at',a.updated_at,
        'plaid_env',a.plaid_env,'plaid_account_id',a.plaid_account_id,'official_name',a.official_name,'type',a.type,'subtype',a.subtype,
        'current_balance',a.current_balance,'available_balance',a.available_balance,'iso_currency_code',a.iso_currency_code,
        'connected_at',a.connected_at,'created_at',a.created_at,'last_sync_at',a.last_sync_at,'connection_state_version',a.connection_state_version,
        'reconnected_at',a.reconnected_at,'sync_gap_started_at',a.sync_gap_started_at,'sync_gap_last_event_at',a.sync_gap_last_event_at,'sync_gap_event_count',a.sync_gap_event_count),
      'item',jsonb_build_object('institution_id',i.institution_id,'institution_name',i.institution_name,'reconnect_state',i.reconnect_state,'status',i.status,
        'is_active',i.is_active,'disconnected_at',i.disconnected_at,'error_code',i.error_code,'updated_at',i.updated_at,
        'last_success_at',i.last_success_at),
      'latest_run',latest,'last_checkpoint',successful,'metrics',metrics,
      'mapped_to_qbo',exists(select 1 from public.plaid_qbo_account_mappings where business_id=p_business_id and plaid_account_id=a.plaid_account_id),
      'auto_post_enabled',coalesce(policy,false),'qbo_token_status',token_status,'qbo_token_active',token_active,'qbo_token_status_at',token_at,'qbo_token_connected_at',token_connected_at));
  end loop;
  return jsonb_build_object('observed_at',now(),'accounts',accounts);
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.plaid_residual_reconciliation_rows(p_business_id uuid, p_batch_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(transaction_id uuid, classification text, held boolean, releasable boolean, requires_live_qbo_attestation boolean, evidence_fingerprint text, non_hold_fingerprint text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
  with evidence as (
    select coalesce(br.admitted_transaction_id,(br.payload->>'transaction_id')::uuid) tid, tc.posting_hold_batch_id=p_batch_id is_held,
      to_jsonb(br) br_json,to_jsonb(bt) bt_json,to_jsonb(tc) tc_json,to_jsonb(r) r_json,to_jsonb(q) q_json,
      to_jsonb(j) j_json, attempts.all_rows attempt_json, matches.all_rows match_json, pairs.all_rows pair_json,
      case
        when bt.id is null or tc.id is null or r.id is null
          or bt.plaid_account_id is distinct from b.summary->'before'->>'account_id'
          or bt.plaid_env is distinct from b.plaid_env
          or (tc.posting_hold_batch_id is not null and tc.posting_hold_batch_id<>p_batch_id) then 'evidence_changed'
        when r.status='processing' and r.locked_at>now()-interval '10 minutes' then 'categorization_lease_active'
        when r.status='processing' then 'categorization_lease_stale'
        when r.status='dead_letter' then 'unresolved_dead_letter'
        when r.status in ('pending','failed') then 'categorization_processing'
        when q.status in ('pending','processing') then 'pending_qbo_receipt'
        when q.status='unknown' then 'unknown_qbo_receipt'
        when q.status='failed' or tc.posting_status='posting_failed' or j.state in ('failed','processing','reconciling')
          or (attempts.latest_status='failed' and coalesce(q.status,'')<>'posted') then 'failed_qbo_attempt'
        when bt.accounting_review_reason ilike '%duplicate%' or tc.meta->>'possible_qbo_duplicate'='true'
          or tc.meta->>'duplicate_risk'='true' or bt.raw->>'possible_qbo_duplicate'='true'
          or matches.ambiguous then 'possible_qbo_duplicate'
        when bt.is_archived or bt.pending or tc.is_archived or bt.accounting_review_required
          or tc.accounting_review_required or tc.post_after is not null
          or coalesce(tc.meta->>'posting_in_progress','false')='true' then 'protected_workflow'
        when q.status='posted' and q.qbo_txn_id is not null then 'existing_posted_receipt'
        when tc.status='posted' and tc.qbo_txn_id is not null and tc.posted_at is not null then 'existing_posted_receipt'
        when tc.status in ('matched','matched_existing_qbo') or tc.reconciled_at is not null
          or matches.confirmed then 'matched_existing_qbo'
        when tc.status in ('excluded','ignored') or (tc.meta->>'is_personal'='true'
          and tc.decided_by='user' and tc.decided_at is not null and tc.review_status='handled') then 'excluded_or_personal'
        when bt.direction is distinct from 'OUTFLOW' or bt.check_number is not null
          or coalesce(bt.transaction_type,'') ~* '(transfer|refund|payroll|tax|loan|payment)'
          or coalesce(bt.name,'') ~* '(\m(transfer|payroll|loan|refund|autopay)\M|DEPOSIT INTUIT|TRAN FEE INTUIT)'
          or coalesce(tc.meta->>'taxonomy_type','') ~* '(transfer|refund|payroll|tax|loan|cc_payment|check)'
          or tc.meta ? 'protected_workflow' or pairs.present then 'protected_workflow'
        when tc.status in ('needs_review','uncategorized') and not (tc.decided_by='user'
          and tc.decided_at is not null and tc.review_status='handled'
          and coalesce(tc.review_reopened_at,'-infinity'::timestamptz)<=tc.decided_at) then 'needs_user_review'
        when nullif(tc.final_qbo_account_id,'') is null then 'needs_user_review'
        when tc.status='handled' and tc.review_status='handled' then 'handled_without_posting'
        when tc.status in ('approved','auto_approved','handled','needs_review') and tc.review_status='handled'
          then 'safe_for_reviewed_release'
        else 'needs_user_review'
      end c
    from public.plaid_recovery_batch_rows br
    join public.plaid_recovery_batches b on b.id=br.batch_id and b.business_id=br.business_id
    left join public.bank_transactions bt on bt.id=coalesce(br.admitted_transaction_id,(br.payload->>'transaction_id')::uuid) and bt.business_id=br.business_id
    left join public.transaction_categorizations tc on tc.transaction_id=bt.id and tc.business_id=bt.business_id
    left join public.bookkeeping_processing_requests r on r.transaction_id=bt.id and r.business_id=bt.business_id
    left join public.qbo_posted_transactions q on q.transaction_id=bt.id and q.business_id=bt.business_id
    left join public.bookkeeping_posting_jobs j on j.transaction_id=bt.id and j.business_id=bt.business_id
    left join lateral (
      select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(pa) order by pa.id) all_rows,
        (array_agg(pa.status order by pa.attempted_at desc,pa.id desc))[1] latest_status
      from public.bookkeeping_post_attempts pa where pa.business_id=br.business_id and pa.transaction_id=bt.id
    ) attempts on true
    left join lateral (
      select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(to_jsonb(m),
        (select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(mi) order by mi.id) from public.bank_qbo_match_items mi where mi.business_id=m.business_id and mi.match_id=m.id),
        (select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(mh) order by mh.id) from public.bank_qbo_match_history mh where mh.business_id=m.business_id and mh.match_id=m.id)) order by m.id) all_rows,
        coalesce(bool_or(m.status='confirmed'),false) confirmed,
        coalesce(bool_or(m.status in ('ambiguous','needs_confirmation','candidate','match_check_unavailable')),false) ambiguous
      from public.bank_qbo_matches m where m.business_id=br.business_id and m.bank_transaction_id=bt.id
    ) matches on true
    left join lateral (
      select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(to_jsonb(p),
        (select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(pe) order by pe.id) from public.credit_card_payment_pair_events pe where pe.business_id=p.business_id and pe.pair_id=p.id)) order by p.id) all_rows,
        count(*)>0 present
      from public.credit_card_payment_pairs p where p.business_id=br.business_id
        and (p.checking_transaction_id=bt.id or p.credit_card_transaction_id=bt.id)
    ) pairs on true
    where br.business_id=p_business_id and br.batch_id=p_batch_id
      and (b.summary->>'workflow_kind'='residual_orphan' or br.admitted_transaction_id is not null)
  )
  select tid,c,coalesce(is_held,false),coalesce(is_held,false) and c in
    ('existing_posted_receipt','matched_existing_qbo','excluded_or_personal','handled_without_posting','safe_for_reviewed_release'),
    c in ('handled_without_posting','safe_for_reviewed_release'),
    encode(sha256(convert_to(jsonb_build_array(br_json,bt_json,tc_json,r_json,q_json,j_json,attempt_json,match_json,pair_json,c)::text,'UTF8')),'hex'),
    encode(sha256(convert_to(jsonb_build_array(br_json,bt_json,tc_json-'posting_hold_batch_id'-'updated_at',r_json,q_json,j_json,attempt_json,match_json,pair_json)::text,'UTF8')),'hex')
  from evidence order by tid;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.clear_approved_plaid_residual_holds(p_business_id uuid, p_batch_id uuid, p_manifest_id uuid, p_ids uuid[])
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
declare n integer;
begin
  update public.transaction_categorizations set posting_hold_batch_id=null
    where business_id=p_business_id and posting_hold_batch_id=p_batch_id and transaction_id=any(p_ids)
      and exists(select 1 from public.plaid_recovery_batches b where b.id=p_batch_id and b.business_id=p_business_id
        and b.summary->'residual_reconciliations'->p_manifest_id::text->>'release_txid'=txid_current()::text
        and b.summary->'residual_reconciliations'->p_manifest_id::text->'approved_ids' @> to_jsonb(p_ids));
  get diagnostics n=row_count;
  return n;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_plaid_reconnect_sync_lease()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if new.sync_lease_owner is not null and new.sync_lease_owner is distinct from old.sync_lease_owner
    and old.reconnect_state->>'state' in ('identity_review_required','new_item_identity_required') then return null; end if;
  return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.plaid_bounded_recovery_fingerprint(p_business_id uuid)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
  select encode(sha256(convert_to(jsonb_build_array(
    (select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) order by id) from public.bank_transactions t where business_id=p_business_id),
    (select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) order by id) from public.transaction_categorizations t where business_id=p_business_id),
    (select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) order by id) from public.qbo_posted_transactions t where business_id=p_business_id),
    (select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) order by id) from public.plaid_accounts t where business_id=p_business_id),
    (select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) order by id) from public.plaid_account_lineage_decisions t where business_id=p_business_id),
    (select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) order by id) from public.plaid_qbo_account_mappings t where business_id=p_business_id)
  )::text,'UTF8')),'hex');
$function$

relations.name: insights_history
relations.view:
SELECT i.id,
    i.user_id,
    i.business_id,
    i.module,
    i.type,
    i.severity,
    i.title,
    i.body,
    i.metrics,
    i.primary_cta,
    i.secondary_cta,
    i.tags,
    i.source_event_id,
    i.created_at,
    i.expires_at,
    i.snoozed_until,
    ir.read_at IS NOT NULL AS is_read
   FROM insights i
     LEFT JOIN insight_reads ir ON ir.insight_id = i.id;

SELECT business_id,
    business_name,
    customer_user_id AS user_id,

SELECT business_id,
    date_trunc('month'::text, created_at)::date AS month,
    lower(COALESCE(cost_type, 'other'::text)) AS category,
    sum(amount) AS amount
   FROM job_costs jc
  GROUP BY business_id, (date_trunc('month'::text, created_at)::date), (lower(COALESCE(cost_type, 'other'::text)))
  ORDER BY (date_trunc('month'::text, created_at)::date) DESC, (sum(amount)) DESC;

relations.name: jobs_profitability
relations.view:
SELECT j.business_id,
    j.id AS job_id,
    j.job_name,
    COALESCE(r.revenue, 0::numeric) AS revenue,
    COALESCE(c.cost_total, 0::numeric) AS cost_total,
    COALESCE(r.revenue, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(c.cost_total, 0::numeric) AS profit,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(r.revenue, 0::numeric) > 0::numeric THEN round((COALESCE(r.revenue, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(c.cost_total, 0::numeric)) / COALESCE(r.revenue, 0::numeric) * 100::numeric, 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS margin,
    date_trunc('month'::text, COALESCE(r.first_rev_at, c.first_cost_at, j.created_at))::date AS month
   FROM jobs j
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT client_revenue.job_id,
            sum(client_revenue.revenue) AS revenue,
            min(client_revenue.created_at) AS first_rev_at
           FROM client_revenue
          GROUP BY client_revenue.job_id) r ON r.job_id = j.id
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT job_costs.job_id,
            sum(job_costs.amount) AS cost_total,
            min(job_costs.created_at) AS first_cost_at
           FROM job_costs
          GROUP BY job_costs.job_id) c ON c.job_id = j.id;

relations.name: positions_view
relations.view:
SELECT p.user_id,
    ia.name AS account_name,
    s.ticker,
    s.name AS security_name,
    s.asset_class,
    s.currency,
    p.quantity,
    COALESCE(p.average_price, NULL::numeric) AS average_price,
    p.cost_basis_total,
    pc.price,
    p.quantity * pc.price AS market_value,
    p.quantity * pc.price - COALESCE(p.cost_basis_total, 0::numeric) AS unrealized_pl,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(p.cost_basis_total, 0::numeric) = 0::numeric THEN NULL::numeric
            ELSE (p.quantity * pc.price - p.cost_basis_total) / p.cost_basis_total * 100::numeric
        END AS unrealized_pl_pct,
    pc.price_as_of
   FROM positions p
     JOIN securities s ON s.id = p.security_id
     JOIN investment_accounts ia ON ia.id = p.account_id
     LEFT JOIN prices_cache pc ON pc.security_id = s.id;

relations.name: ar_aging
relations.view:
SELECT business_id,
    id AS invoice_id,
    COALESCE(customer_name, 'Client'::text) AS client,
    GREATEST(COALESCE(amount_due, 0) - COALESCE(amount_paid, 0), 0)::numeric AS amount,
    GREATEST(0, CURRENT_DATE - COALESCE(due_date, created_at::date)) AS days,
    COALESCE(due_date, created_at::date) AS due_date,
    status
   FROM invoices i
  WHERE GREATEST(COALESCE(amount_due, 0) - COALESCE(amount_paid, 0), 0) > 0;

relations.name: bookkeeping_transaction_feed_classification
relations.view:
SELECT bt.id AS transaction_id,
    bt.business_id,
    bt.plaid_account_id AS connected_account_id,
    classify_bookkeeping_primary_feed(bt.pending, tc.status, tc.review_status, tc.posting_status, tc.meta, tc.qbo_txn_id, tc.posted_at, tc.reconciled_at) AS primary_feed,
    COALESCE(tc.meta ->> 'taxonomy_type'::text, 'regular'::text) AS transaction_kind,
    COALESCE(tc.meta ->> 'resolution_type'::text, tc.meta ->> 'resolution'::text, 'categorize_new'::text) AS resolution_type,
    COALESCE(tc.review_status,
        CASE
            WHEN tc.status = ANY (ARRAY['approved'::text, 'auto_approved'::text, 'handled'::text, 'failed'::text]) THEN 'handled'::text
            ELSE 'needs_review'::text
        END) AS categorization_state,
    tc.final_qbo_account_id AS selected_qbo_account_id,
    bt.pending AS bank_pending,
    classify_bookkeeping_posting_outcome(tc.status, tc.posting_status, tc.post_error, tc.last_post_attempt_at, tc.post_after, tc.meta, tc.qbo_txn_id, tc.posted_at) AS posting_outcome,
    tc.qbo_txn_id AS qbo_entity_id,
    COALESCE(tc.meta ->> 'cc_payment_pair_id'::text, tc.meta ->> 'incoming_deposit_match_id'::text) AS matched_relationship_id,
    COALESCE(tc.post_error, tc.meta ->> 'post_block_reason'::text) AS failure_review_reason,
    COALESCE(tc.meta ->> 'merchant_group_operation_id'::text, (tc.meta -> 'manual_approval'::text) ->> 'operation_id'::text, tc.meta ->> 'post_intent_id'::text) AS last_operation_id,
    COALESCE(tc.last_post_attempt_at, tc.posted_at, tc.reviewed_at, tc.updated_at, bt.updated_at) AS last_status_at
   FROM bank_transactions bt
     LEFT JOIN transaction_categorizations tc ON tc.business_id = bt.business_id AND tc.transaction_id = bt.id
  WHERE bt.is_archived IS FALSE;

relations.name: bizzy_chat_bookkeeping_feed
relations.view:
SELECT c.business_id,
    c.transaction_id,
    bt.date AS transaction_date,
    bt.name AS description,
    bt.merchant_name,
    bt.amount,
    bt.direction,
    c.primary_feed,
    c.posting_outcome,
    c.failure_review_reason,
    c.last_status_at,
    bt.plaid_transaction_id,
    bt.duplicate_fingerprint,
    bt.raw ->> 'original_description'::text AS original_description,
    COALESCE(bt.raw ->> 'memo'::text, bt.raw ->> 'payment_meta_reference_number'::text) AS memo,
    COALESCE(bt.counterparty_name, bt.merchant_name, bt.name) AS normalized_merchant_name,
    bt.signed_amount,
    pa.name AS account_name,
    tc.final_qbo_account_name AS gl_category,
    c.qbo_entity_id,
    c.matched_relationship_id,
    'bank_transactions+bookkeeping_transaction_feed_classification'::text AS source_provenance
   FROM bookkeeping_transaction_feed_classification c
     JOIN bank_transactions bt ON bt.business_id = c.business_id AND bt.id = c.transaction_id
     LEFT JOIN plaid_accounts pa ON pa.business_id = bt.business_id AND pa.plaid_account_id = bt.plaid_account_id
     LEFT JOIN transaction_categorizations tc ON tc.business_id = bt.business_id AND tc.transaction_id = bt.id
  WHERE bt.is_archived IS FALSE;

relations.name: bookkeeping_handled_posting_disposition_violations
relations.view:
SELECT tc.business_id,
    tc.transaction_id,
    tc.status,
    tc.final_qbo_account_id,
    tc.post_after,
    tc.post_error,
    tc.updated_at,
        CASE
            WHEN bt.pending IS TRUE THEN 'pending_transaction_not_postable'::text
            WHEN tc.post_error = 'incoming_deposit_needs_match'::text AND COALESCE(tc.meta ->> 'resolution_mode'::text, tc.meta #>> '{incoming_deposit_resolution,resolution_mode}'::text[], tc.meta #>> '{incoming_deposit_resolution,resolution}'::text[]) = 'categorize_as_new'::text THEN 'final_new_deposit_resolution_has_active_match_blocker'::text
            WHEN tc.final_qbo_account_id IS NULL THEN 'missing_final_qbo_account'::text
            WHEN tc.status = 'auto_approved'::text AND lower(COALESCE(tc.meta ->> 'safe_to_auto_post'::text, 'false'::text)) <> 'true'::text THEN 'automatic_posting_safety_not_established'::text
            WHEN tc.post_after IS NULL AND tc.post_error IS NULL THEN 'missing_posting_disposition'::text
            ELSE 'contradictory_posting_disposition'::text
        END AS violation_code
   FROM transaction_categorizations tc
     JOIN bank_transactions bt ON bt.business_id = tc.business_id AND bt.id = tc.transaction_id
     LEFT JOIN bookkeeping_posting_jobs bpj ON bpj.business_id = tc.business_id AND bpj.transaction_id = tc.transaction_id
  WHERE (tc.status = ANY (ARRAY['approved'::text, 'auto_approved'::text, 'handled'::text, 'failed'::text])) AND tc.qbo_txn_id IS NULL AND tc.posted_at IS NULL AND tc.excluded_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(tc.is_archived, false) IS FALSE AND COALESCE(bt.is_archived, false) IS FALSE AND (bpj.state IS NULL OR (bpj.state = ANY (ARRAY['blocked'::text, 'failed'::text, 'cancelled'::text]))) AND (tc.final_qbo_account_id IS NULL OR tc.post_error = 'incoming_deposit_needs_match'::text AND COALESCE(tc.meta ->> 'resolution_mode'::text, tc.meta #>> '{incoming_deposit_resolution,resolution_mode}'::text[], tc.meta #>> '{incoming_deposit_resolution,resolution}'::text[]) = 'categorize_as_new'::text OR tc.status = 'auto_approved'::text AND lower(COALESCE(tc.meta ->> 'safe_to_auto_post'::text, 'false'::text)) <> 'true'::text OR tc.post_after IS NULL AND tc.post_error IS NULL);
